notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
Updates:

 As requested by the players, camera controls have been introduced (use the arrow keys or the gamepad's right stick to look up or down) . 
 The achievement localization bug has been fixed . 
 Language preferences are now saved correctly . 
 4k display compatibility issues have been fixed . 

News:
Jelly Killer has been released for the OUYA game console, as well as for Android and iOS devices. 
On mobile devices, you can check the game out for free!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12047410/b14046c23169dd5ba0713da95d8b51914b072d37.png       
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12047410/d0706bd16e56c082e0ac9b26b848cf8534e1a435.png
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12047410/ecfc01b68ea6e4d76814f6bf438250a9670c9dc7.png

Have fun!

notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
New difficulty level!!! Hard!

Bug Fixes:
- Quick restart after death, press any key. 
- Press “E”, “Enter” and “J” to grab or escape the body. 
- Quick enter the game, press “Alt”+”F4”. 
- Hitbox of lasers. Bug fixed. 
- Fixed a bug of automatic shooting. 
- The guard, seeing through the walls. Bug fixed. 
- Fixed a bug of conveyor. 
- Fixed a bug of menu item for widescreen monitors. 

Have a nice game!
